focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需紧急核查碳排放数据
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起正式征收碳关税。中国钢铁、铝、化肥、电力等行业出口商须在过渡期内完成碳排放数据申报，否则将面临高额默认值惩罚。企业应尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，与欧盟进口商确认数据传递机制，并评估供应链脱碳路径。未合规者可能丧失欧盟市场竞争力，建议立即启动合规审计。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.09.11
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transition Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Carbon Data
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period ends in late 2026, with definitive carbon tariffs applying from 2027. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, fertilisers, and electricity must complete emissions data reporting during the transition or face hefty default-value penalties. Companies should establish product-level carbon footprint accounting, coordinate data transmission with EU importers, and assess supply chain decarbonisation. Non-compliance risks losing EU market access; an immediate compliance audit is advisable.

case.title: 新加坡仲裁案：约定“友好协商”未果后启动仲裁，条款效力获支持
case.summary: 某中国企业与东南亚合作方约定争议先友好协商，协商不成提交新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）。因对方拒绝协商，中国企业直接申请仲裁，仲裁庭认定协商条款不构成仲裁前置强制程序，裁决有效。新加坡高等法院随后驳回撤销申请，确认“协商不成”可单方认定。该案提示：起草多层次争议解决条款时，应明确协商期限与启动仲裁的触发条件，避免因程序瑕疵引发管辖权争议。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心案例摘要 · 2026.09
case.title_en: SIAC Arbitration Clause Upheld Despite Unsuccessful 'Friendly Negotiation'
case.summary_en: A Chinese company and its Southeast Asian partner agreed to negotiate amicably before referring disputes to SIAC. When the counterparty refused to negotiate, the Chinese firm commenced arbitration directly. The tribunal held that the negotiation clause was not a mandatory precondition, and the award stood. The Singapore High Court later dismissed a set-aside application, confirming that 'failure to negotiate' can be determined unilaterally. The case highlights the need to specify negotiation deadlines and trigger conditions in multi-tier dispute resolution clauses to avoid jurisdictional challenges.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动“白名单”制度，便利企业合规传输
policy.summary: 广东省近期发布大湾区跨境数据流动管理试点办法，针对金融、医疗、贸易等重点领域建立数据出境“白名单”，允许符合条件的企业在备案后向港澳传输数据。该制度简化了安全评估流程，降低了企业合规成本。建议大湾区企业梳理数据资产，评估是否落入白名单场景，并完善与港澳合作方的数据保护协议，同时关注后续配套细则的出台。
policy.source: 来源：广东省政务服务数据管理局 · 2026.09
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches Cross-Border Data 'Whitelist' to Ease Compliance
policy.summary_en: Guangdong province has issued pilot measures for cross-border data flow in the Greater Bay Area, establishing a data export 'whitelist' for key sectors such as finance, healthcare, and trade. Qualified enterprises may transfer data to Hong Kong and Macao after filing, simplifying security assessments and reducing compliance costs. Companies in the GBA should map their data assets, assess whether they fall under whitelist scenarios, strengthen data protection agreements with Hong Kong/Macao partners, and monitor upcoming implementing rules.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government Services and Data Management Bureau · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中国科技企业需重构出海架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部近期拟将对外投资审查范围扩展至更多敏感技术领域，并强化对“规避行为”的追溯。中国科技企业在美投资或通过第三国间接投资可能受波及。建议企业立即排查现有投资架构，评估是否涉及受限技术；在新交易中引入“反向CFIUS”条款，预留退出机制；同时考虑分散投资目的地，并利用香港、新加坡等合规通道。应建立动态监测机制，将地缘政治风险纳入董事会决策议程。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 研究部
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Screening Requires Rethinking for Chinese Tech Firms
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury is poised to broaden outbound investment screening to more sensitive technologies and enhance retroactive scrutiny of circumvention. Chinese tech companies investing in the US or indirectly via third countries may be affected. Companies should immediately review existing investment structures, assess exposure to restricted technologies, incorporate 'reverse CFIUS' clauses with exit mechanisms in new deals, and consider diversifying destinations using compliant channels like Hong Kong and Singapore. A dynamic monitoring mechanism and board-level geopolitical risk agenda are essential.
